Йохимбин.about: Alpha-2 blocker: there is an effect for ED (old MA), but the price is blood pressure, pulse, impulsivity.
Йохимбин.caution: Yohimbine (alpha-2 adrenergic blocker) from Pausinystalia yohimbe. Historically used for erectile dysfunction. The FDA approved it in the 1990s, but research stopped after Viagra was introduced in 1998. There are NO contemporary systematic reviews. Serious side effects: tachycardia, anxiety, increased blood pressure. Interacts with many medications. In the EU and Canada it is prohibited as a dietary supplement. Not recommended without medical supervision.
effects: Fat burning is weak, the price is side effects
Йохимбин.food_sources: The bark of the Pausinystalia yohimbe tree is not food; Its “yohimbe” extracts are prohibited in a number of countries outside of pharmacies.
Йохимбин.guidelines: MA 1998 (7 RCT, ED): OR 3.85 vs placebo; There are no current reviews. RCT 2022 (n=18): Sprint is better. The side effects are significant.
Йохимбин.how_to_choose: Start 2.5 mg, maximum 10 mg, with a doctor and blood pressure/pulse monitoring; not with antidepressants; prohibited in EU/Canada.

Йохимбин.myths: “Burn fat” - one RCT (n=20), no strength. “Safe” - tachycardia, blood pressure, impulsivity; It is prohibited as a dietary supplement in the EU/Canada.
